description:
CapTech Sports is hiring a Data Engineer to build the pipelines and platforms behind competition data for leagues, tours, federations, and rights holders. You will work with scoring, schedules, results, officiating, and player and ball tracking and sensor feeds, and turn live and historical event data into datasets that teams can trust and use. 
 This is a mid-level role. You will own pipelines from design through production with light guidance, work directly with client engineers and data providers, and help raise the bar for the engineers around you. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Build and operate batch and streaming pipelines that ingest from scoring systems, tracking and sensor providers, camera and officiating systems, and league and partner sources. 

 Handle real-time and near-real-time event data with the availability and latency live competition demands. 

 Model competition data (athletes, teams, events, schedules, results, positional and tracking data) into trusted, documented datasets. 

 Reconcile data across providers and systems, including late, corrected, and out-of-order events. 

 Add data quality tests, monitoring, lineage, and alerting so problems surface before an event, not during it. 

 Deliver data products and APIs for officiating, analytics, broadcast and media, and AI use cases such as computer vision. 

 Work with architects, strategists, and analysts to turn requirements into designs, and explain your work clearly to client stakeholders. 

 Review code and mentor less experienced engineers. 

 
 Technical Skills & Tools:
 Area-
 What we look for 
 Languages 
 Python and SQL, written for production 
 Streaming and real-time 
 Kafka, Kinesis, Event Hubs, Pub/Sub, Spark Structured Streaming, or Flink 
 Data platforms 
 Databricks, Snowflake, Spark; lakehouse and warehouse patterns 
 Time-series and spatial data 
 Event, tracking, and sensor data formats; positional data modeling 
 Transformation and orchestration 
 dbt, Airflow, or equivalent 
 Cloud 
 AWS, Azure, or GCP, including storage, compute, and managed data services 
 Engineering practice 
 Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code (such as Terraform), automated testing 
 APIs and integration 
 REST and event-based integrations with scoring, tracking, and vendor systems 
 Qualifications 
 We hire for this role at the mid-level. Typically that means 4 to 8 years of experience building and running production data pipelines in a cloud environment. 
 Strong Python and SQL. 

 Experience with streaming or event-driven data, and with at least one modern data platform such as Databricks or Snowflake. 

 Ability to own a pipeline or data domain end to end, make sound trade-offs between speed, cost, and reliability, and work independently with client technical teams. 

 Clear written and verbal communication. 

 Interest in sports; prior experience with competition, scoring, tracking, or sensor data is a plus. 

 Consulting or client-facing experience preferred. 

 Preferred: cloud data certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP); experience with computer vision, tracking, or sensor data. 

 
 We want everyone at CapTech to be able to envision a lasting and rewarding career here, which is why we offer a variety of career paths based on your skills and passions.  You decide where and how you want to develop, and we help get you there with customizable career progression and a comprehensive benefits package to support you along the way.  Alongside our suite of traditional benefits encompassing generous PTO, health coverage, disability insurance, paid family leave and more, we’ve launched extended benefits to help meet our employees’ needs. 
 CapFlex – Employee-first mentality that supports a remote and hybrid workforce and empowers daily flexibility while servicing our clients
 Learning & Development – Programs offering certification and tuition support, digital on-demand learning courses, mentorship, and skill development paths
 Modern Health –A mental health and well-being platform that provides 1:1 care, group support sessions, and self-serve resources to support employees and their families through life’s ups and downs
 Carrot Fertility –Inclusive fertility and family-forming coverage for all paths to parenthood – including adoption, surrogacy, fertility treatments, pregnancy, and more – and opportunities for employer-sponsored funds to help pay for care
 Fringe –A company paid stipend program for personalized lifestyle benefits, allowing employees to choose benefits that matter most to them – ranging from vendors like Netflix, Spotify, and GrubHub to services like student loan repayment, travel, fitness, and more
 Employee Resource Groups – Employee-led committees that embrace and incorporate diversity and inclusion into our day-to-day operations
 Philanthropic Partnerships – Opportunities to engage in partnerships and pro-bono projects that support our communities. 
 401(k) Matching – Generous matching and no vesting period to help you continue to build financial wellness
 CapTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a culture of equality, inclusion and fairness — each foundational to our core values.  We strive to create a diverse environment where each employee is encouraged to bring their unique ideas, backgrounds and experiences to the workplace. For more information about our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging efforts, click  HERE . 
 At this time, CapTech cannot transfer nor sponsor a work visa for this position. Applicants must be authorized to work directly for any employer in the United States without visa sponsorship.
